spsBuyerOrgId.description: Unique identifier for buying organization within SPS Commerce.

spsSellerOrgId.description: Unique identifier for selling organization within SPS Commerce.

partnerId.description: Value assigned by buyer that uniquely identifies the vendor.

availableQuantity.description: Quantity of current stock that is on hand for sale or use.

availableDate.description: The date that the Available Quantity will be available for sale.

projectedQuantities.description: Quantities that is currently being manufactured and/or shipped and is not available for immediate shipment or stocking.

quantityLastUpdated.description: Date and Time the ItemRegistries was created.

upc.description: Consumer level or customer unit product identification number.

gtin.description: Global Trade Item Number which is an item identifier that encompasses all product identification numbers such as UPC, EAN, ITF, etc. and can be assigned at various packing levels

ean.description: International Article Number, aka European Article Number, which is the European equivalent of the United States UPC[Universal Product Code].

ndc.description: National Drug Code or NDC is a unique, universal product identifier for drugs. Primarily used in the pharmaceutical industry.

Limit.description: Number of results requested to be returned.

Offset.description: Number of items to skip before including the number of limit results in the request.

PagingOffset.description: Offset Paging result schema for all collection responses.

date.description: The date that the  projected quantity is expected to be available for immediate shipment or stocking.

quantity.description: Quantity that is currently being manufactured and/or shipped and is not available for immediate shipment or stocking.

SpsItemId.description: A unique identifier for an item within SPS Commerce.

SpsLocationId.description: A unique identifier for a location within SPS Commerce.

TotalCount.description: The total count of all unique available records (results) across all paginated queries of the endpoint.

locationId.description: Unique value assigned to identify a location.

name.description: Primary free-form textual description of a location.

state.description: Code[Standard State/Province] as defined by appropriate government agency

postalCode.description: International postal zone excluding punctuation and blanks[Zip Code for United States].

country.description: Human readable description identifying the country.
